title: Portrait and Bell
author: Wren Lockridge
blurb: Mirabel Halloran, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
